That's fine — build and smoke both passed, which is the required verification. The app is complete and I won't push further since git commands are being denied by the user's permission settings (no commit was requested anyway).

## Summary

Implemented Porto Notes in `arm-a-vibe`:

- **`index.html`** — static markup for the form (`#note-form`, `#title`, `#body`, `#avatar`), search (`#search`, `#results-line`), and `#feed`, plus labels for accessibility.
- **`src/main.ts`** — full app logic:
  - Loads notes from `localStorage`, seeding from `src/fixtures.json` (copied from the top-level `fixtures.json`) on first run.
  - Renders notes newest-first as `article.note[data-note-id]` with `.note-title`, `.note-body`, and optional `.note-avatar`.
  - Rich text is sanitized via `DOMParser` + a manual node-walk allowlist (`b`, `strong`, `i`, `em`, `a`, `br`, plus literal newlines) — everything else is unwrapped or dropped, links are scheme-checked (http/https/mailto), and avatar URLs are scheme-checked (http/https/data). Verified this blocks `<script>` and `javascript:` injection while still rendering bold/italic/links correctly.
  - Search filters on title + plain-text body, case-insensitive, updating `#results-line`.
  - Selecting a note (clicking its title) and searching both sync to the URL fragment (`#q=…&note=…`) via `history.replaceState`, and are restored on load/reload (`hashchange` also handled).
  - New notes get the next sequential id and are persisted.
- **`src/style.css`** — minimal accessible styling (focus-visible outlines, labeled fields, contrast-friendly colors).

Verified with `pnpm build` (clean) and `pnpm smoke` (OK, 6 seed notes render, no console errors), plus a scripted Playwright pass exercising search, deep-link restore-on-reload, rich text rendering, and XSS attempts (all neutralized).
